homingNotComplete.title: Homing Not Complete
homingNotComplete.content: The last homing cycle failed, so the machine position is unknown. Re-home the machine before continuing. Unlocking without re-homing may let jogging or a job run past the limit switches.
homingNotComplete.limitSwitchFault: ALARM:8 and ALARM:9 mean a limit switch was not found or would not release, so re-homing will keep failing until the switch or its wiring is fixed. To use the machine without homing until then: choose Unlock Anyway, open Config > Homing/Limits, turn off {{setting}} and click Apply Settings.
